From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@ventra.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@ventra.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Technical deep-dive: timeboxing options & pre-call config

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the discovery yesterday — great conversation and helped us prioritize the items to cover in a technical deep-dive.

Goal: 60-75 minute architecture walk-through focused on inference topology, KV cache behavior with long-context LLMs, and integration points for telemetry/audit logs.

Proposed time windows (PST):
- Wed Jul 14, 10:00-11:15
- Thu Jul 15, 09:00-10:15
- Fri Jul 16, 13:00-14:15

Agenda (high level):
- 5m intro / goals
- 20m topology & deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- 20m performance knobs (batching, quantization, KV cache)
- 15m security/compliance touchpoints (data flow, retention, KMS)
- 10m Q&A + next steps

Prep: attaching a short one-pager of ask/requirements and the security questionnaire you flagged — if you can skim before the call it will help us be crisp.

[Attachment: ventra-reqs-onepager.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: ventra-security-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

If none of those windows work, share 2-3 times that are good for your team and we’ll loop in the right engineers. Ben, Rishi — can you join and own the platform/ops sections?

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Appreciate the quick follow-up and clear agenda. We’re keen to focus the call on the KV cache behavior (we have long transcript contexts) and the telemetry story.

Quick scheduling notes: the morning windows are a bit tight for our infra folks this week. Would any of these work instead (PST)?
- Wed Jul 14, 15:00-16:15

Also — can we tighten the session to 60 minutes and surface links to any relevant runbooks ahead of time? That helps us prep the right people.
